# virgoAi

> virgoAi is an AI Content Studio. It turns one input (a YouTube link, transcript, uploaded video, script, or idea) into a complete content package: story, script, characters, scenes, images, video, narration, subtitles and thumbnail.

## Product

- [Home](http://localhost:5173/): what virgoAi does and how a run is made.
- [Studio](http://localhost:5173/): sign in and make content.
